_note: Map bank. Each map is a seed for the site's Continent Map Generator (default options) and the number of the site the card features. expect is what that seed made when it was picked; render fails if the generator has since changed it. Everything on a map is generated and fictional. status: draft until the owner approves a map; week is its slot in the posting order.
